name: Acceptance test 9 - partial Deny narrows but does not eliminate destruction
note: IAM-707 fixturization. A broad s3:DeleteObject Allow on arn:aws:s3:::*/* with a narrow Deny on audit-archive/*. An over-broad deny must NOT suppress the residual dangerous scope: DESTRUCTIVE-ACTION stays HIGH over the broad remaining scope. The narrow deny is RECORDED as a `denies` graph edge (audit-archive excluded) but does not neutralize deletion across other buckets.
